Pelicans @ Spurs 4/10 7:00 - Murphy and Murray out, likely blowout
Trail Blazers @ Knicks 7/10 6:30 - Morant out, Knicks banged up
Grizzlies @ Timberwolves 6/10 7:00 - Edwards out, Boozer out too

games.notes: Morant and Sharpe out for Portland, Avdija questionable. Anunoby doubtful and Towns questionable for the champion Knicks. Best game on the board and should be close.
Edwards and DiVincenzo out for Minnesota, Isaiah Evans questionable; Boozer and Jerami Grant out for Memphis. Two good teams, both shorthanded, should stay competitive.
Murphy, Murray and Mathurin out for New Orleans. Tobias Harris and Dylan Harper out for San Antonio, but the Spurs should cruise, likely blowout.
Ingram and Beal out for the Clippers; Washington doubtful and Clayton questionable for Dallas. Lively out too. Two bad teams, skip unless bored.
Tatum resting and White out for Boston; Kings are 1-14. Celtics should win easily, likely blowout and a skip.
